status.summary: Original issuer RNS 8732V states that the extension at CRA’s data centre in Prague’s Žižkov district houses servers for CRA’s cloud business, C4C. This present-tense physical hosting supports existing-campus operation. Separate contracted sales, forecast utilisation, revenue and capacity figures are not adopted; no new commissioning, installation day or completed extension date is inferred.

locator.identity_review: Native facility 215 names DC Tower Zizkov CRa, alias TVPM Prague Zizkov, links cra.cz and gives Mahlerovy sady 1. Original CRA material explicitly names DC TOWER in the Žižkov transmitter compound at Mahlerovy sady; the TIA registry independently identifies the same DC Tower (PHMO) at Mahlerovy sady 2699/1, Prague 3. The expanded address retains the house/orientation-number form rather than implying a different property. Nested organization Skokanská 2117/1 is a distinct address and is excluded.

additions.distinctness_review: All five canonical 117 tables have no scoped identity, alias, exact coordinate or Mahlerovy address matches. Historical and current queues contain TTC and Lužice holds and references to the already admitted separate Prague Gateway campus; these are not DC Tower admissions or renames. The nearest admitted representative point is CRA Prague Gateway, about 15.925 km away. This is one Žižkov host; C4C servers, private halls, the earlier extension and transmitter infrastructure do not create additional sites.
additions.successor_review: Reviewed the September 23 issuer report, current original CRA company-feed excerpt, current data-centre service page and data-centre news index. Recent company-feed items concern Lužice GPU deployments, business events and Prague Gateway; none establishes a later contradictory Žižkov closure or relocation. The August 4 nearly complete expansion post overlaps historical October 2025 completion reporting and is not promoted to a new phase. The report date is kept separate from the June 30 financial tables. This bounded public-source check is not a guarantee that every later statement was indexed.

The retained later company-feed items concern Japan and Indonesia projects, sustainability, energy and corporate events; this feed excerpt contains no named SIN6 item or contradictory SIN6 closure or relocation. The current Singapore locations page continues to identify SIN6 in Loyang. This is a bounded review, not exhaustive later-publication coverage.
